decision.topic: ADR identity, status and supersession authority
decision.note: The approved option quarantines the five ambiguous ADR identities in place. Quarantine is a containment record, not an identity decision: it selects no canonical topic, renumbers nothing, and leaves the collision ledger under its own pending decision.

immutableRefs.note: Approval intake, EPOCH-03 chain, registry, gap addendum and the ADR collision ledger are read by digest only; application state lives in the application-state ledger.

invariants: Quarantine preserves ambiguity: all five identities stay ambiguous, every canonicalTopic stays null, and this record selects no topic, owner or authority for any of them.
Quarantine is not resolution: no identity is renumbered, aliased or superseded, and every alias and supersession field stays null.

Every machine consumer stays closed: machineConsumerUnblocked stays false for all five identities, and no classification rule, blocker list, node or workflow is rewritten to accept an ambiguous marker.
The identities are quarantined in place and non-authoritatively: the ADR markers stay exactly where they are in their source documents, and this record moves, renames and deletes nothing.
The five-row ADR collision ledger stays read-only evidence: byte-identical, ambiguous, pending, appliedByThisRecord=false, and its renumber, alias and supersession floors stay false.
Each quarantined row binds the committed topics and the committed source-binding and machine-consumer counts; the gap addendum carries the same five ambiguous identities as an independent source.
The registry keeps all ten decisions pending and unselected; the closure intake and EPOCH-03 chain are read by digest only.
No planning artifact here is runtime implementation evidence, a code-start permit or a readiness claim.
nonGoals: do not select a canonical topic, owner or status for ADR-E1, ADR-M1, ADR-S1, ADR-X1 or the A5/ADR-0022 collision
do not renumber, alias, supersede, merge, split, move or delete any ADR identity or its source markers
do not unblock, relax or rewrite any machine consumer rule, blocker list, generated node or workflow that currently refuses an ambiguous ADR marker
do not apply, reshape or re-hash the ADR collision ledger, and do not promote its pending decision
do not write runtime, platform or kernel product code, and do not treat quarantine as an ADR identity decision

rollback.trigger: a quarantined identity gains a canonical topic, alias or supersession, a machine consumer is unblocked, the committed topics or binding counts drift, the collision ledger bytes or pending status change, or a fail-closed gate flag flips
rollback.action: revert this quarantine record, its application-state row, the attestation contract, tests, pack sections and gate wiring as one shard
